0.0: Welcome to the Sleepywood Hotel. Now, I have a favor to ask. If you accept, I'll give you a piece of clothing. Just listen to my story.
0.1: I have a son that can do me no wrong. But one day he took a book that is very dear to me and left. That book...hmmm...I can't divulge much about it, but it is very, very important to me...
0.2: If you get me that book back safely, I'll give you a comfortable article of clothing, perfect for saunas like this. Do we have a deal?

yes.0: Ah, thank you! But it won't be easy to find my son, he's a sneaky little devil. My gut tells me that he went to the #b#m105010000##k to look at the Drakes. He seems to enjoy that.
yes.1: Bring the book to #bBirchwillow Sauna#k if you find it. I place my trust in you.

no.0: I'll reward you handsomely for your work so if you ever change your mind, please let me know.

1.0: Who're you? Did my dad send you? Aw, man. That guy cares more about this stupid book than he does about me. Well, I won't let you have it! I'm gonna... argh, my stomach!

npc.0: You still haven't found my book? I told you, I will reward you handsomely if you retrieve that book from the boy. He should be near #m105010000#.

QuestInfo.name: [Sleepywood] Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Wetbottom is in a pickle. Go visit him in the Sleepywood.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Wetbottom, the bald man in the Sleepywood, lost his favorite book to his runaway son Ronnie. He's offered you some very cushy sauna gear if you get the book back. Ronnie's known for watching the Drakes, so he's likely to be around the #bSilent Swamp#k. It's a weird request, but that robe looked very comfortable.
QuestInfo.2: You found Ronnie in #bSilent Swamp#k for Mr. Wetbottom.
